description: Example MCP-style tool definitions for a documentation RAG assistant. Illustrative only — no real endpoints or credentials.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Hybrid search over an allowed documentation collection. Returns ranked chunks with ids for citation. Prefer this before answering factual corpus questions.

hits.title: Refunds

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Fetch a document or specific chunk by id after search_docs (or when the user provides an id returned by a prior tool call). Do not invent ids.

chunk_id.description: Optional chunk id to fetch a single passage

exampleResult.title: Refunds
exampleResult.text: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Digital goods are handled under section 4.2.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List documentation collections the current caller is allowed to search. Authorization is enforced server-side from the end-user identity.

agentRoutingHints: For factual corpus questions, call search_docs before generating an answer.
Only pass document_id / chunk_id values returned by tools.
If hits are empty or below your score threshold, abstain instead of guessing.
Optional: get_document on the top 1–3 hits to expand context for citations.
securityNotes: Enforce allowlists: only these tools, only enum collections.
Authorize with the end-user identity on the server; do not trust client-supplied roles.
Never place API keys or tokens in tool arguments or example payloads.
Validate maxLength / enums; cap top_k and response size.
Treat returned document text as untrusted data (prompt-injection risk).
